source: Flapping Airplanes demo video (HD, 45.6 s), read frame by frame. Numbers are what the video shows; nothing here was measured by us.
system: KVM: training + serving + Doom, one kernel launch on one GPU
baseline_system: Megatron (training) + vLLM (serving), each timed individually, no Doom
notes: The baseline is Megatron and vLLM each timed on their own (not sharing the GPU), against KVM running all three jobs at once.
Training loss starts near 11.5 (about ln of a 100k vocabulary), so the model is a real LLM-sized vocabulary; training throughput is about 355k tokens per second.
The SM split is a static partition: 116 SMs training, 24 inference, 8 Doom.
